task_prompts.go-flag--url:
Add a new flag type to urfave/cli: `cli.URLFlag`, which accepts an absolute URL (it must have a scheme and a host) and parses it into a `*url.URL`. Its value is read with a new accessor `cmd.URL(name string) *url.URL`. A value it cannot parse must make the command fail with an error. Examples of valid input: `https://example.com/x`, `http://localhost:8080`. Examples of invalid input: `example.com`, `not a url`, `://x`.

Include tests, list the new flag in the flags documentation, and update the generated API documentation, as the project does for new flag types.

Examples of invalid input: `0`, `70000`, `http`.

Its value is read with a new accessor `cmd.Percent(name string) float64`. A value it cannot parse must make the command fail with an error. Examples of valid input: `50%`, `12.5`, `100%`. Examples of invalid input: `101%`, `-1`, `abc`.

task_prompts.go-flag--bytesize:
Add a new flag type to urfave/cli: `cli.ByteSizeFlag`, which accepts a size in bytes written as a number with an optional unit: `B`, `KB`, `MB`, `GB` (powers of 1000) or `KiB`, `MiB`, `GiB` (powers of 1024), case-insensitive, as an `int64` number of bytes (a bare number is bytes; `1.5MB` is `1500000`). Examples of invalid input: `10XB`, `-1KB`, `KB`.
